hooks.command: bash -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel | sed "s|D:/|/mnt/d/|; s|\\\\|/|g"); PROJECT="$ROOT/domains/game-engine/godotProjects/slayDemo/client/slay-demo"; echo "=== slayDemo 提交后状态快照 ==="; echo "最新提交: $(git log --oneline -1)"; echo "总提交数: $(git rev-list --count main)"; echo ""; echo "数据规模:"; for f in cards relics potions enemies encounters; do count=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open(\"$PROJECT/data/$f.json\")); print(len(d.get(\"$f\", [])))"); echo "  $f: $count"; done; echo ""; echo "代码规模:"; echo "  scripts: $(find $PROJECT/scripts -name \"*.gd\" | wc -l) .gd 文件"; echo "  tests:   $(find $PROJECT/tests -name \"*.gd\" | wc -l) .gd 文件"; echo ""; echo "请根据以上快照，分析本次提交完成了什么，并规划下一步推进计划。"'
